name: Kettlebell Renegade Row
steps: Place two stable kettlebells shoulder-width apart, grasp the handles and step back into a plank with your feet wide.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes tightly, pressing one handle firmly into the floor while rowing the other kettlebell back toward your hip.
Lower that kettlebell smoothly back to the floor directly beneath your shoulder.
Row the opposite kettlebell next, alternating arms on each repetition while keeping your hips level.
tips: Keep your hips square to the floor and avoid twisting your pelvis upward as you row.
Use wide, flat-bottomed kettlebells on a non-slip floor so the supporting handle stays rock solid.
